```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Core libraries (loaded once)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)

# Cohort sizes (for ≈expected scaling)
TOTAL_N    <- 310  # Full target cohort
SCREENED_N <- 108  # Subset with current data

# ---- Helpers ----
# Print tibble/data.frame safely with n control
safe_print_tbl <- function(x, n = 50, ...) {
  if (inherits(x, "tbl_df")) print(x, n = n, ...) else print(tibble::as_tibble(x), n = n, ...)
}

# Robust date parser: handles Excel serials & common strings
as_date_safe <- function(x) {
  v <- as.character(x)
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
  out <- rep(as.Date(NA), length(v))
  # Excel serials (roughly 1955–2064)
  is_serial <- !is.na(num) & num > 20000 & num < 60000
  out[is_serial] <- as.Date(num[is_serial], origin = "1899-12-30")
  # Strings
  left <- !is_serial
  if (any(left)) {
    parsed <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(v[left], orders = c("Y-m-d","m/d/Y","d/m/Y","m/d/y","d/m/y","Ymd"), tz = "UTC"))
    out[left] <- as.Date(parsed)
  }
  # Clamp to reasonable range
  bad <- is.na(out) | year(out) < 2000 | year(out) > 2100
  out[bad] <- as.Date(NA)
  out
}

safe_min_date <- function(x) { dx <- as_date_safe(x); if (all(is.na(dx))) as.Date(NA) else suppressWarnings(min(dx, na.rm = TRUE)) }
safe_max_date <- function(x) { dx <- as_date_safe(x); if (all(is.na(dx))) as.Date(NA) else suppressWarnings(max(dx, na.rm = TRUE)) }

# Build long ctDNA (values + dates) from wide columns
build_ctdna_long <- function(dat, id_col) {
  val <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "tp", values_to = "ctdna_value_raw") %>%
    mutate(ctdna_value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", gsub(",", "", as.character(ctdna_value_raw))))) )
  dt  <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+_date$")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "tp_date", values_to = "ctdna_date_raw")
  out <- val %>%
    mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp, "\\d+"))) %>%
    left_join(dt %>% mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp_date, "\\d+"))) %>% select(all_of(id_col), tp_idx, ctdna_date_raw),
              by = c(id_col, "tp_idx")) %>%
    mutate(ctdna_date = as_date_safe(ctdna_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_date)) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), ctdna_date, ctdna_value)
  out
}

# Clean/harmonize regimen names and settings
clean_regimen <- function(x) {
  y <- tolower(str_squish(x))
  case_when(
    str_detect(y, "enfortumab.*pembrolizumab|\\bev\\b.*\\bpemb|\\bev/pembro") ~ "Enfortumab Vedotin + Pembrolizumab",
    str_detect(y, "gem.*cis.*nivo")                                              ~ "Gemcitabine + Cisplatin + Nivolumab",
    str_detect(y, "gem.*cis")                                                    ~ "Gemcitabine + Cisplatin",
    str_detect(y, "gem.*carb")                                                   ~ "Gemcitabine + Carboplatin",
    str_detect(y, "^nivolumab|\\bnivo\\b")                                     ~ "Nivolumab",
    str_detect(y, "pembrolizumab|\\bpembro\\b")                               ~ "Pembrolizumab",
    str_detect(y, "atezolizumab|\\batezo\\b")                                 ~ "Atezolizumab",
    str_detect(y, "durvalumab|\\bdurva\\b")                                   ~ "Durvalumab",
    str_detect(y, "clinical trial")                                             ~ "Clinical trial (other)",
    str_detect(y, "other \\(see notes\\)|^other$")                              ~ "Other (see notes)",
    TRUE                                                                          ~ str_to_title(y)
  )
}

# Categorize therapy type: ICI, ADC, Chemo, or combinations
categorize_therapy_type <- function(x) {
  y <- tolower(str_squish(x))
  has_ici <- str_detect(y, "nivolumab|pembrolizumab|atezolizumab|durvalumab|avelumab|ipi|ipilimumab|tremelimumab|pd-1|pd-l1|ctla-4|checkpoint|immunotherapy")
  has_adc <- str_detect(y, "enfortumab|vedotin|sacituzumab|govitecan|t-dxd|trastuzumab.*deruxtecan|adc|antibody.*drug.*conjugate")
  has_chemo <- str_detect(y, "gemcitabine|cisplatin|carboplatin|paclitaxel|docetaxel|vinflunine|methotrexate|doxorubicin|cyclophosphamide|ifosfamide|mvac|ddmvac|chemotherapy|chemo")
  
  # Determine category (use & instead of && for vectorized operations)
  case_when(
    has_ici & has_adc & has_chemo ~ "ICI+ADC+Chemo",
    has_ici & has_adc ~ "ICI+ADC",
    has_ici & has_chemo ~ "ICI+Chemo",
    has_adc & has_chemo ~ "ADC+Chemo",
    has_ici ~ "ICI",
    has_adc ~ "ADC",
    has_chemo ~ "Chemo",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

clean_setting <- function(x) {
  y <- tolower(str_squish(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    y %in% c("neo","neoadjuvant","neoadjuvant therapy","neoadjuvant systemic therapy") ~ "Neoadjuvant",
    y %in% c("adjuvant","adjuvant therapy","adjuvant systemic therapy")                   ~ "Adjuvant",
    y %in% c("palliative","metastatic","1l metastatic","2l metastatic")                  ~ "Palliative",
    y %in% c("","na","n/a","unknown","other","other (see notes)")                    ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE ~ str_to_title(y)
  )
}
```

```{r load_and_clean, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Load and tidy the raw sheet
# ==============================
file_path <- "Natera_Sheet_UTUC.xlsx"
raw <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Sheet1", col_names = FALSE)

# Transpose: first column = variable names; columns = patients
var_names <- raw[[1]]
dat <- as.data.frame(t(raw[, -1]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# Make column names unique to avoid duplicate name errors
colnames(dat) <- make.unique(var_names, sep = "_")
var_names_unique <- colnames(dat)

# Extract primary site and histology BEFORE cleaning names
# Row 8 = primary tumor location, Row 16 = histology (in original Excel)
primary_site_row <- 8
histology_row <- 16

# Get the column names by position (since make.unique preserves order)
# Row 8 = primary tumor location, Row 16 = histology
primary_site_col_name <- if (primary_site_row <= length(var_names_unique)) var_names_unique[primary_site_row] else NULL
histology_col_name <- if (histology_row <= length(var_names_unique)) var_names_unique[histology_row] else NULL

cat("Primary site column name (row 8, position", primary_site_row, "):", primary_site_col_name, "\n")
cat("Histology column name (row 16, position", histology_row, "):", histology_col_name, "\n")
cat("Column exists check - Primary site:", primary_site_col_name %in% names(dat), "\n")
cat("Column exists check - Histology:", histology_col_name %in% names(dat), "\n")

# Identify patient ID column before cleaning - it's "Record ID (Linking key)"
id_col_temp <- if ("Record ID (Linking key)" %in% names(dat)) {
  "Record ID (Linking key)"
} else if ("record_id_linking_key" %in% names(dat)) {
  "record_id_linking_key"
} else {
  # Try to find patient ID column
  id_candidates <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("id.*linking|linking.*key|record.*id", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(id_candidates) > 0) {
    id_candidates[1]
  } else {
    names(dat)[2]  # Usually second column after "Primary Variables"
  }
}

cat("Using patient ID column:", id_col_temp, "\n")

# Extract these columns before cleaning - keep row order intact
patient_characteristics_pre <- dat %>%
  mutate(row_num = row_number()) %>%
  select(row_num, all_of(id_col_temp))

# Add primary site - use column index directly to avoid name issues
if (!is.null(primary_site_col_name) && primary_site_row <= ncol(dat)) {
  # Use column index instead of name to be safe
  primary_site_values <- as.character(dat[[primary_site_row]])
  # Trim whitespace and handle NA values - but preserve valid values like "Renal Pelvis"
  primary_site_values <- str_trim(primary_site_values)
  # Only set to NA if truly empty or "NA" string - preserve all other values
  primary_site_values[primary_site_values == "" | primary_site_values == "NA" | is.na(primary_site_values)] <- NA_character_
  
  # Extract by matching row_num (which is 1-based row index in dat)
  patient_characteristics_pre <- patient_characteristics_pre %>%
    mutate(primary_site = ifelse(row_num <= length(primary_site_values), 
                                 primary_site_values[row_num], 
                                 NA_character_))
  
  # Debug: Check specific patients
  cat("\nExtraction debug for patients 311, 334, 335:\n")
  for (pid in c("311", "334", "335")) {
    pid_match <- patient_characteristics_pre[[id_col_temp]] == pid | 
                 as.character(patient_characteristics_pre[[id_col_temp]]) == pid |
                 as.numeric(patient_characteristics_pre[[id_col_temp]]) == as.numeric(pid)
    if (any(pid_match, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      idx <- which(pid_match)[1]
      cat("Patient", pid, "- row_num:", patient_characteristics_pre$row_num[idx], 
          ", primary_site extracted:", patient_characteristics_pre$primary_site[idx], 
          ", direct check dat[[8]][", patient_characteristics_pre$row_num[idx], "]:", 
          as.character(dat[[primary_site_row]][patient_characteristics_pre$row_num[idx]]), "\n")
    } else {
      cat("Patient", pid, "not found in patient_characteristics_pre\n")
    }
  }
  
  cat("Extracted primary site from column index", primary_site_row, ":", primary_site_col_name, "\n")
  cat("Total primary_site values extracted:", sum(!is.na(patient_characteristics_pre$primary_site)), 
      "out of", nrow(patient_characteristics_pre), "patients\n")
} else {
  patient_characteristics_pre <- patient_characteristics_pre %>%
    mutate(primary_site = NA_character_)
  cat("WARNING: Primary site column not found at index", primary_site_row, "!\n")
}

# Add histology - use column index directly
if (!is.null(histology_col_name) && histology_row <= ncol(dat)) {
  # Use column index instead of name to be safe
  histology_values <- as.character(dat[[histology_row]])
  patient_characteristics_pre <- patient_characteristics_pre %>%
    mutate(histology = histology_values[row_num])
  cat("Extracted histology from column index", histology_row, ":", histology_col_name, "\n")
} else {
  patient_characteristics_pre <- patient_characteristics_pre %>%
    mutate(histology = NA_character_)
  cat("WARNING: Histology column not found at index", histology_row, "!\n")
}

# Clean column names to snake_case
dat <- clean_names(dat)

# Filter out patients with blank/empty Record IDs early in the process
# This ensures all downstream processing excludes these patients
id_col_temp_clean <- if ("record_id_linking_key" %in% names(dat)) {
  "record_id_linking_key"
} else {
  # Find the ID column after cleaning
  id_candidates <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("record.*id|id.*linking|linking.*key", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(id_candidates) > 0) {
    id_candidates[1]
  } else {
    names(dat)[2]  # Usually second column
  }
}

# Filter out blank/empty/NA Record IDs
# Keep only rows where the ID is not NA, not empty string, and not "NA"
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(id_check = as.character(.data[[id_col_temp_clean]])) %>%
  filter(!is.na(id_check)) %>%
  filter(str_trim(id_check) != "") %>%
  filter(str_trim(id_check) != "NA") %>%
  select(-id_check)

cat("Total patients after filtering blank Record IDs:", nrow(dat), "\n")
cat("Sample patient IDs (first 10):", paste(head(dat[[id_col_temp_clean]], 10), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Sample patient IDs (last 10):", paste(tail(dat[[id_col_temp_clean]], 10), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Patient ID (create if missing)
id_col <- if ("record_id_linking_key" %in% names(dat)) "record_id_linking_key" else {
  dat$record_id_linking_key <- seq_len(nrow(dat)); "record_id_linking_key"
}

# Since patient_characteristics_pre already has the patient ID (as id_col_temp),
# we just need to rename it to match the cleaned id_col name
# The row order is preserved, so we can directly rename the column

# First, verify what columns we have
cat("patient_characteristics_pre columns:", paste(names(patient_characteristics_pre), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("id_col_temp:", id_col_temp, "\n")
cat("id_col (target):", id_col, "\n")

# Rename id_col_temp to id_col if they're different
if (id_col_temp %in% names(patient_characteristics_pre)) {
  if (id_col_temp != id_col) {
    patient_characteristics <- patient_characteristics_pre %>%
      rename(!!sym(id_col) := !!sym(id_col_temp))
    cat("Renamed", id_col_temp, "to", id_col, "\n")
  } else {
    patient_characteristics <- patient_characteristics_pre
  }
} else {
  # If id_col_temp is not found, try to get it from dat after cleaning
  dat_with_row <- dat %>%
    mutate(row_num = row_number())
  
  if (id_col %in% names(dat_with_row)) {
    join_data <- dat_with_row %>% 
      select(row_num, all_of(id_col))
    
    patient_characteristics <- patient_characteristics_pre %>%
      left_join(join_data, by = "row_num")
    cat("Joined id_col from dat\n")
  } else {
    # Last resort: create sequential ID
    patient_characteristics <- patient_characteristics_pre %>%
      mutate(!!sym(id_col) := row_num)
    cat("Created sequential ID column:", id_col, "\n")
  }
}

# Verify we have the required columns
cat("patient_characteristics columns:", paste(names(patient_characteristics), collapse = ", "), "\n")
required_cols <- c(id_col, "histology", "primary_site")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(patient_characteristics))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  cat("ERROR: Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  stop("Cannot proceed without required columns")
}

# Now select the final columns (remove row_num if it exists)
patient_characteristics <- patient_characteristics %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), histology, primary_site)

# Convert any *date* columns
date_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
dat <- dat %>% mutate(across(all_of(date_cols), as_date_safe))

# Normalize ctDNA value column names (e.g., ct_dna_level13 -> ct_dna_level_13)
names(dat) <- str_replace_all(names(dat), regex("^ct[_ ]?dna[_ ]?level(\\d+)$", ignore_case = TRUE), "ct_dna_level_\\1")

# Ensure ctDNA numeric columns are numeric
ctdna_value_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
if (length(ctdna_value_cols)) {
  dat[ctdna_value_cols] <- lapply(dat[ctdna_value_cols], function(x) {
    y <- gsub(",", "", as.character(x))
    y <- gsub("^<\\s*", "", y)
    y[y %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "na", "n/a", "Not detected", "Undetected", "NEGATIVE", "Negative", "neg", "ND")] <- NA
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y))
  })
}

# Build long ctDNA data
ctdna_long <- build_ctdna_long(dat, id_col)

# Build therapy long data
therapy_long <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "regimen_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var) %>%
  filter(!is.na(regimen_raw), regimen_raw != "")

# Get ctDNA timeline per patient
ctdna_timeline <- ctdna_long %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
  summarise(
    first_ctdna_date = min(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_ctdna_date = max(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Get follow-up dates
follow_up_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date|last.*visit.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(follow_up_cols) > 0) {
  follow_up_dates <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(follow_up_cols[1])) %>%
    rename(follow_up_date = all_of(follow_up_cols[1])) %>%
    mutate(follow_up_date = as_date_safe(follow_up_date))
} else {
  # Use last ctDNA date as proxy if no follow-up date column
  follow_up_dates <- ctdna_timeline %>%
    rename(follow_up_date = last_ctdna_date)
  cat("Note: Using last ctDNA date as follow-up date proxy\n")
}

# Build therapy start/end data (needed before calculating first_therapy_start)
therapy_start_dates <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+_start_date$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "start_date_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var) %>%
  mutate(start_date = as_date_safe(start_date_raw))

# Get first therapy start date per patient
first_therapy_start <- therapy_start_dates %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_date)) %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
  summarise(first_therapy_start = min(start_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Get first surgery date per patient (for upper tract, this might be nephroureterectomy or other procedures)
first_surgery_date <- NULL
surgery_date_cols_temp <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("surgery.*date|surgery_\\d+_date", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(surgery_date_cols_temp) > 0) {
  surgery_data_temp <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(surgery_date_cols_temp)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "surgery_var", values_to = "surgery_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(surgery_date = as_date_safe(surgery_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(surgery_date)) %>%
    group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
    summarise(first_surgery_date = min(surgery_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  first_surgery_date <- surgery_data_temp
}

# Start with ALL patients from dat, not just those with ctDNA data
# This ensures patients like 334, 335 are included even if they don't have ctDNA dates
# Note: blank Record IDs have already been filtered out from dat above
all_patients <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col)) %>%
  distinct()

cat("Total patients for timeline (after blank ID filtering):", nrow(all_patients), "\n")

# Combine patient timeline info and calculate first known event
# Start with all patients and left join all timeline data
patient_timeline <- all_patients %>%
  left_join(ctdna_timeline, by = id_col) %>%
  left_join(follow_up_dates, by = id_col) %>%
  left_join(first_therapy_start, by = id_col) %>%
  {if (!is.null(first_surgery_date)) {
    left_join(., first_surgery_date, by = id_col)
  } else {
    mutate(., first_surgery_date = as.Date(NA))
  }} %>%
  mutate(
    # First known event = minimum of: first ctDNA, first therapy start, first surgery, follow-up start
    first_known_event = pmin(
      first_ctdna_date,
      first_therapy_start,
      first_surgery_date,
      follow_up_date,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    # Use follow-up date or last ctDNA date as end anchor
    time_anchor = coalesce(follow_up_date, last_ctdna_date),
    # Per-patient bar: time from first known event to last follow-up
    follow_up_interval_days = as.numeric(time_anchor - first_known_event),
    follow_up_interval_months = follow_up_interval_days / 30.44
  ) %>%
  # Ensure time_anchor and first_known_event are Date objects
  mutate(
    time_anchor = as.Date(time_anchor),
    first_known_event = as.Date(first_known_event),
    # If time_anchor is missing but first_known_event exists, use first_known_event as anchor
    # Use case_when or direct assignment to preserve Date class (ifelse converts to numeric)
    time_anchor = case_when(
      is.na(time_anchor) & !is.na(first_known_event) ~ first_known_event,
      TRUE ~ time_anchor
    )
  ) %>%
  # Recalculate intervals - ensure both are Date objects before subtraction
  mutate(
    follow_up_interval_days = case_when(
      !is.na(time_anchor) & !is.na(first_known_event) ~ as.numeric(time_anchor - first_known_event),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    follow_up_interval_months = follow_up_interval_days / 30.44
  ) %>%
  # Only filter out patients with NO timeline data at all
  # Must have at least first_known_event (which means they have at least one date: ctDNA, therapy, surgery, or follow-up)
  filter(!is.na(first_known_event))

# Debug: Check patients before and after filtering
cat("\n=== Before filtering patient_timeline ===\n")
patient_timeline_before_filter <- patient_timeline
cat("Total patients before filter:", nrow(patient_timeline_before_filter), "\n")
for (pid in c("311", "334", "335")) {
  patient_check <- patient_timeline_before_filter %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] == pid | .data[[id_col]] == as.numeric(pid) | as.character(.data[[id_col]]) == pid)
  if (nrow(patient_check) > 0) {
    cat("Patient", pid, "BEFORE filter - first_known_event:", as.character(patient_check$first_known_event[1]), 
        ", primary_site:", patient_check$primary_site[1], "\n")
  } else {
    cat("Patient", pid, "NOT FOUND before filter\n")
  }
}

# Apply the filter
patient_timeline <- patient_timeline %>%
  filter(!is.na(first_known_event))

# Debug: Check patients after filtering
cat("\n=== After filtering patient_timeline ===\n")
cat("Total patients after filter:", nrow(patient_timeline), "\n")
for (pid in c("311", "334", "335")) {
  patient_check <- patient_timeline %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] == pid | .data[[id_col]] == as.numeric(pid) | as.character(.data[[id_col]]) == pid)
  if (nrow(patient_check) > 0) {
    cat("Patient", pid, "AFTER filter - first_known_event:", as.character(patient_check$first_known_event[1]), 
        ", primary_site:", patient_check$primary_site[1], "\n")
  } else {
    cat("Patient", pid, "FILTERED OUT - no first_known_event\n")
  }
}

# Get all ctDNA data for all patients (anchored to first known event)
plot_ctdna <- ctdna_long %>%
  inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), time_anchor, first_known_event), by = id_col) %>%
  mutate(
    # Time from first known event (anchor = 0)
    months_from_anchor = as.numeric(ctdna_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
    ctdna_status = case_when(
      ctdna_value == 0 ~ "Negative",
      ctdna_value > 0 ~ "Positive",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

# Build therapy end data
therapy_end_dates <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+_end_date$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "end_date_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var) %>%
  mutate(end_date = as_date_safe(end_date_raw))

therapy_settings <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+_treatment_setting$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "setting_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var)

# Combine therapy information
therapy_complete <- therapy_long %>%
  left_join(therapy_start_dates %>% select(all_of(id_col), therapy_idx, start_date), 
            by = c(id_col, "therapy_idx")) %>%
  left_join(therapy_end_dates %>% select(all_of(id_col), therapy_idx, end_date), 
            by = c(id_col, "therapy_idx")) %>%
  left_join(therapy_settings %>% select(all_of(id_col), therapy_idx, setting_raw), 
            by = c(id_col, "therapy_idx")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_date)) %>%
  mutate(
    regimen_clean = clean_regimen(regimen_raw),
    setting_clean = clean_setting(setting_raw),
    therapy_type = categorize_therapy_type(regimen_raw)
  )

# Get therapy periods relative to first known event
therapy_periods <- therapy_complete %>%
  inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), first_known_event, time_anchor), by = id_col) %>%
  mutate(
    start_months = as.numeric(start_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
    end_months = case_when(
      !is.na(end_date) ~ as.numeric(end_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # Clean setting for labeling
    setting_label = case_when(
      setting_clean == "Neoadjuvant" ~ "Neoadjuvant",
      setting_clean == "Adjuvant" ~ "Adjuvant",
      setting_clean == "Palliative" ~ "Palliative",
      is.na(setting_clean) | setting_clean == "" ~ "Clinical trial",
      TRUE ~ "Clinical trial"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), start_months, end_months, therapy_type, regimen_clean, setting_clean, setting_label)

# Get surgery dates (relative to first known event)
surgery_date_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("surgery.*date|surgery_\\d+_date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
surgery_dates <- NULL
if (length(surgery_date_cols) > 0) {
  surgery_dates <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(surgery_date_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "surgery_var", values_to = "surgery_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(surgery_date = as_date_safe(surgery_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(surgery_date)) %>%
    inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), first_known_event), by = id_col) %>%
    mutate(surgery_months = as.numeric(surgery_date - first_known_event) / 30.44) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), surgery_date, surgery_months)
  cat("Surgery dates found:", nrow(surgery_dates), "events\n")
}

# Get radiation dates (relative to first known event)
rad_start_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^(radiation|rt).*?(start|date_start|start_date)$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
radiation_dates <- NULL
if (length(rad_start_cols) > 0) {
  radiation_dates <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(rad_start_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "rad_var", values_to = "rad_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(rad_date = as_date_safe(rad_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(rad_date)) %>%
    inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), first_known_event), by = id_col) %>%
    mutate(rad_months = as.numeric(rad_date - first_known_event) / 30.44) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), rad_date, rad_months)
  cat("Radiation dates found:", nrow(radiation_dates), "events\n")
}

# Get metastatic relapse dates (relative to first known event)
metastatic_relapse_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("metastatic.*relapse.*date|relapse.*date|metastasis.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
metastatic_relapse_dates <- NULL
if (length(metastatic_relapse_cols) > 0) {
  metastatic_relapse_dates <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(metastatic_relapse_cols)) %>%

    mutate(relapse_date = as_date_safe(relapse_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(relapse_date)) %>%
    inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), first_known_event), by = id_col) %>%
    mutate(relapse_months = as.numeric(relapse_date - first_known_event) / 30.44) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), relapse_date, relapse_months)
  cat("Metastatic relapse dates found:", nrow(metastatic_relapse_dates), "events\n")
}
```

```{r on_treatment_swimmer_plots}
# Function to create swimmer plot for a specific histology type
create_histology_plot <- function(histology_name) {
  # Get patients with this histology
  patients_this_histology <- patient_timeline %>%
    filter(histology == histology_name) %>%
    pull(.data[[id_col]])
  
  # Debug: Check if Renal Pelvis patients are in this histology
  if (histology_name %in% c("urothelial cell carcinoma", "Unknown")) {
    renal_pelvis_in_hist <- patient_timeline %>%
      filter(histology == histology_name) %>%
      filter(primary_site == "Renal Pelvis" | str_detect(primary_site, regex("renal.*pelvis", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
      pull(.data[[id_col]])
    if (length(renal_pelvis_in_hist) > 0) {
      cat("Histology", histology_name, "contains", length(renal_pelvis_in_hist), "Renal Pelvis patients:", paste(renal_pelvis_in_hist, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  if (length(patients_this_histology) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Sample if too many patients - but ALWAYS include Renal Pelvis patients
  renal_pelvis_pids <- patient_timeline %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
    filter(primary_site == "Renal Pelvis" | str_detect(primary_site, regex("renal.*pelvis", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
    pull(.data[[id_col]])
  
  n_show <- min(30, length(patients_this_histology))
  if (length(patients_this_histology) > n_show) {
    set.seed(123)
    # Ensure Renal Pelvis patients are always included
    other_patients <- setdiff(patients_this_histology, renal_pelvis_pids)
    n_other <- n_show - length(renal_pelvis_pids)
    if (n_other > 0 && length(other_patients) > 0) {
      sampled_other <- sample(other_patients, size = min(n_other, length(other_patients)), replace = FALSE)
      patients_this_histology <- c(renal_pelvis_pids, sampled_other)
    } else {
      patients_this_histology <- renal_pelvis_pids
    }
    cat("Sampled", length(patients_this_histology), "patients for", histology_name, 
        "(including", length(renal_pelvis_pids), "Renal Pelvis patients)\n")
  }
  
  # Order patients by first known event, then by primary site
  patient_order <- patient_timeline %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
    arrange(first_known_event, primary_site, .data[[id_col]]) %>%
    pull(.data[[id_col]])
  
  # Prepare plot data
  plot_timeline_histology <- patient_timeline %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order),
      follow_up_months = as.numeric(time_anchor - first_known_event) / 30.44,
      # Create label with patient ID and primary site
      patient_label = paste0(.data[[id_col]], " (", primary_site, ")")
    )
  
  plot_ctdna_histology <- plot_ctdna %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order),
      ctdna_detectable = ctdna_value > 0
    )
  
  # Get all therapy periods for these patients
  plot_therapy_histology <- therapy_periods %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
    left_join(plot_timeline_histology %>% select(all_of(id_col), follow_up_months), by = id_col) %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order),
      end_months_final = ifelse(is.na(end_months), follow_up_months, end_months),
      setting_label = case_when(
        setting_label == "Neoadjuvant" ~ "Neoadjuvant",
        setting_label == "Adjuvant" ~ "Adjuvant",
        setting_label == "Palliative" ~ "Palliative",
        is.na(setting_label) | setting_label == "" ~ "Clinical trial",
        TRUE ~ "Clinical trial"
      )
    )
  
  # Get surgery dates
  plot_surgery_histology <- if (!is.null(surgery_dates) && nrow(surgery_dates) > 0) {
    surgery_dates %>%
      filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order))
  } else NULL
  
  plot_radiation_histology <- if (!is.null(radiation_dates) && nrow(radiation_dates) > 0) {
    radiation_dates %>%
      filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order))
  } else NULL
  
  plot_relapse_histology <- if (!is.null(metastatic_relapse_dates) && nrow(metastatic_relapse_dates) > 0) {
    metastatic_relapse_dates %>%
      filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_histology) %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order))
  } else NULL
  
  # Calculate x-axis limits
  x_min_data <- c(
    plot_therapy_histology$start_months,
    if (!is.null(plot_surgery_histology) && nrow(plot_surgery_histology) > 0) plot_surgery_histology$surgery_months else NULL,
    if (!is.null(plot_radiation_histology) && nrow(plot_radiation_histology) > 0) plot_radiation_histology$rad_months else NULL,
    plot_ctdna_histology$months_from_anchor
  )
  x_max_data <- c(
    plot_timeline_histology$follow_up_months,
    if (!is.null(plot_relapse_histology) && nrow(plot_relapse_histology) > 0) plot_relapse_histology$relapse_months else NULL,
    plot_therapy_histology$end_months_final
  )
  x_min <- floor(min(x_min_data, na.rm = TRUE)) - 3
  x_max <- ceiling(max(x_max_data, na.rm = TRUE)) + 3
  x_min <- max(x_min, -12)
  x_breaks <- seq(floor(x_min / 6) * 6, ceiling(x_max / 6) * 6, by = 6)
  
  # Create labels for y-axis with primary site
  y_labels <- plot_timeline_histology %>%
    arrange(patient_id_ordered) %>%
    distinct(patient_id_ordered, primary_site) %>%
    mutate(y_label = paste0(patient_id_ordered, " (", primary_site, ")")) %>%
    pull(y_label)
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Per-patient follow-up interval bars
    geom_segment(
      data = plot_timeline_histology,
      aes(x = 0, xend = follow_up_months,
          y = patient_id_ordered, yend = patient_id_ordered),
      linewidth = 3, color = "gray85", alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    # Therapy period bars (color by setting)
    geom_segment(
      data = plot_therapy_histology,
      aes(x = start_months, 
          xend = end_months_final,
          y = patient_id_ordered, yend = patient_id_ordered,
          color = setting_label),
      linewidth = 3.5, alpha = 0.8, lineend = "round"
    ) +
    # ctDNA positive markers
    geom_point(
      data = plot_ctdna_histology %>% filter(ctdna_detectable),
      aes(x = months_from_anchor, y = patient_id_ordered),
      size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "red", color = "white", stroke = 0.3
    ) +
    # ctDNA negative markers
    geom_point(
      data = plot_ctdna_histology %>% filter(!ctdna_detectable),
      aes(x = months_from_anchor, y = patient_id_ordered),
      size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "green3", color = "white", stroke = 0.3
    ) +
    # Surgery events
    {if (!is.null(plot_surgery_histology) && nrow(plot_surgery_histology) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_surgery_histology,
        aes(x = surgery_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 3.5, shape = 15, fill = "darkblue", color = "darkblue"
      )
    }} +
    # Radiation events
    {if (!is.null(plot_radiation_histology) && nrow(plot_radiation_histology) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_radiation_histology,
        aes(x = rad_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 3.5, shape = 17, fill = "darkorange", color = "darkorange"
      )
    }} +
    # Metastatic relapse events
    {if (!is.null(plot_relapse_histology) && nrow(plot_relapse_histology) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_relapse_histology,
        aes(x = relapse_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 5, shape = 23, fill = "red3", color = "darkred", stroke = 1.2
      )
    }} +
    # Vertical line at anchor (time anchor = 0)
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
    # Color scales for therapy setting
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Neoadjuvant" = "#4E79A7",      # Blue
        "Adjuvant" = "#59A14F",          # Green
        "Palliative" = "#9C755F",        # Brown/Tan
        "Clinical trial" = "#F28E2B"      # Orange
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = y_labels) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(histology_name, " (n = ", length(patient_order), ")"),
      x = "Time from First Known Event (months)",
      y = "Patient ID (Primary Site)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8)),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray92", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(l = 10, r = 8, t = 8, b = 8)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, limits = c(x_min, x_max), expand = c(0.02, 0))
  
  return(p)
}

# Create plots for each histology type
plots_list <- list()
for (hist_type in histology_types) {
  p_histology <- create_histology_plot(hist_type)
  if (!is.null(p_histology)) {
    plots_list[[hist_type]] <- p_histology
  }
}

# Arrange plots in grid
if (length(plots_list) > 0) {
  # Order plots by histology type (alphabetically or by frequency)
  histology_order <- names(plots_list)[order(names(plots_list))]
  plots_ordered <- plots_list[histology_order]
  
  # Arrange in grid based on number of plots
  n_plots <- length(plots_ordered)
  if (n_plots == 1) {
    combined_plot <- plots_ordered[[1]]
  } else if (n_plots == 2) {
    combined_plot <- plots_ordered[[1]] | plots_ordered[[2]]
  } else if (n_plots == 3) {
    combined_plot <- (plots_ordered[[1]] | plots_ordered[[2]]) / plots_ordered[[3]]
  } else if (n_plots == 4) {
    combined_plot <- (plots_ordered[[1]] | plots_ordered[[2]]) / (plots_ordered[[3]] | plots_ordered[[4]])
  } else if (n_plots == 5) {
    # For 5 plots, arrange in a 2x3 grid (2 on top, 3 on bottom, or 3 on top, 2 on bottom)
    # Put the most important ones (with Renal Pelvis patients) first
    # Check which plot has Renal Pelvis patients
    has_renal_pelvis <- sapply(plots_ordered, function(p) {
      # Check if this plot's data contains Renal Pelvis patients
      # We'll check by looking at the plot data
      any(grepl("Renal Pelvis", names(plots_ordered), ignore.case = TRUE))
    })
    # Arrange: 3 plots on top row, 2 on bottom row
    combined_plot <- (plots_ordered[[1]] | plots_ordered[[2]] | plots_ordered[[3]]) / 
                     (plots_ordered[[4]] | plots_ordered[[5]])
  } else {
    # For more than 5, arrange in 3x2 grid (show first 6)
    combined_plot <- (plots_ordered[[1]] | plots_ordered[[2]] | plots_ordered[[3]]) / 
                     (plots_ordered[[4]] | plots_ordered[[5]] | plots_ordered[[6]])
    cat("Note: Showing first 6 histology types. Total available:", n_plots, "\n")
  }
  
  # Create legend plot with visual elements
  legend_plot <- ggplot() +
    # ctDNA positive
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.9, size = 3.5, shape = 21, fill = "red", color = "white", stroke = 0.3) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.9, label = "ctDNA+", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # ctDNA negative
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.8, size = 3.5, shape = 21, fill = "green3", color = "white", stroke = 0.3) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.8, label = "ctDNA-", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Surgery
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.7, size = 4, shape = 15, fill = "darkblue", color = "darkblue") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.7, label = "Surgery", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Radiation
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.6, size = 4, shape = 17, fill = "darkorange", color = "darkorange") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.6, label = "Radiation", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Relapse
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.5, size = 5, shape = 23, fill = "red3", color = "darkred", stroke = 1.2) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.5, label = "Metastatic relapse", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Therapy settings - Neoadjuvant
    annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.4, yend = 0.4, linewidth = 4, color = "#4E79A7", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.4, label = "Neoadjuvant", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Therapy settings - Adjuvant
    annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.3, yend = 0.3, linewidth = 4, color = "#59A14F", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.3, label = "Adjuvant", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Therapy settings - Palliative
    annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.2, yend = 0.2, linewidth = 4, color = "#9C755F", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.2, label = "Palliative", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Therapy settings - Clinical trial
    annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.1, yend = 0.1, linewidth = 4, color = "#F28E2B", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.1, label = "Clinical trial", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
  
  # Add overall title and combine with legend
  combined_plot <- combined_plot +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "ctDNA dynamics of upper tract urothelial carcinoma patients",
      subtitle = "Time anchored at first known event (first ctDNA, first therapy start, first surgery, or follow-up start). Separate plots by histology type. Primary tumor site shown in patient labels.",
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5)
      )
    )
  
  # Combine plot with legend on the right
  final_plot <- combined_plot | legend_plot
  final_plot <- final_plot + plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1))
  
  print(final_plot)
  
  cat("\nSwimmer plots created for", length(plots_ordered), "histology type(s):", paste(names(plots_ordered), collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("\nNo patients found for the specified histology types.\n")
}
```
